build_cmd: uv sync && bash compile esp32s3 --examples Blink --no-interactive && cp "$(grep -oE '/[^"]*/tools/esp32-arduino-libs/esp32s3\b' .build/fbuild/esp32s3/build_info_Blink.json | head -n 1)/ld/memory.ld" .build/fbuild/esp32s3/membrowse.ld

uv sync && bash compile esp32c3 --examples Blink --no-interactive && cp "$(grep -oE '/[^"]*/tools/esp32-arduino-libs/esp32c3\b' .build/fbuild/esp32c3/build_info_Blink.json | head -n 1)/ld/memory.ld" .build/fbuild/esp32c3/membrowse.ld

uv sync && bash compile teensy41 --examples Blink --no-interactive && cp "$(grep -oE '/[^"]*/cores/teensy4\b' .build/fbuild/teensy41/build_info_Blink.json | head -n 1)/imxrt1062_t41.ld" .build/fbuild/teensy41/membrowse.ld

uv sync && bash compile uno --examples Blink --no-interactive && cp "$(grep -oE '/[^"]*/avr/bin/avr-gcc\b' .build/fbuild/uno/build_info_Blink.json | head -n 1 | sed 's#/bin/avr-gcc$##')/avr/lib/ldscripts/avr5.x" .build/fbuild/uno/membrowse.ld
